mcp.note: Scaffold — enabled:false until a real server exists under mcp/ with a tools.json declaring `mutates` per tool. SECURITY CONSTRAINT: this repo is a credential vault. A tool that returns a decrypted secret is NOT a read — it must be classified mutates:true (or excluded entirely) so it can never be reached as a side effect of a query. Owned by mcp-maintainer for upkeep; tool behaviour is backend-engineer's.
